# muumuu_domain_auto_renew (Resource)

Manages whether a domain is renewed automatically.

Destroying this resource only removes it from the Terraform state and leaves the setting unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "muumuu_domain" "example" {
  fqdn = "example.com"
}

resource "muumuu_domain_auto_renew" "example" {
  domain_id = data.muumuu_domain.example.id
  enabled   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain (e.g. `MU00000001`).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the domain is renewed automatically.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import muumuu_domain_auto_renew.example <domain_id>
```
